title: On a part sale the deposit message says part sale
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new part sale for this test, part sale 1, for customer A, open, billed to customer B, holding one deposit of $20.00 taken after customer B was picked.
custom_steps:
1. Open part sale 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Hover over the Bill To field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part sale 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The tooltip reads "This part sale has a $20.00 deposit from [customer B's name]. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To."

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)
